fields.Name: T209 - Edit Multiple Fields and Save
fields.Description: Changes two different fields on an Event record in one editing session and saves them together, verifying multi-field save.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity grid — type 'Events' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the exact 'Events' node (or, if the search is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Events). Click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'. Change TWO different fields in the same editing session: set 'Location' to 'Multi Edit 209' AND set 'Capacity' to 222. With both changed, click the 'Save Changes' button in the top banner once. Verify the save succeeds with no error and BOTH changes are reflected. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Two different fields (Location and Capacity) were changed on an Event record before saving
A single Save Changes persisted both changes with no error
No error messages or crash pages
